processing_policy.name: conservative-invariant-coverage-v1
processing_policy.coverage: Missing, duplicate, or extra integer invariant IDs make an otherwise valid, assignable rating structurally invalid. Affected answers are uncertain and cannot pass.
processing_policy.strictness: All other schema, case/candidate assignment, raw-evidence, prompt, and frozen-setting checks remain strict. Raw negative or contradictory verdicts are retained.
processing_policy.retention: No model check is synthesized, repaired, removed, or rewritten; every existing response and its raw evidence is retained.
processing_policy.resumption: Only previously unstarted primary review requests may run, with at most four workers. Generation requests are never scheduled.
